answer: Each identity seals its timber manifest hash with 70 credits at the wharf registry. At reveal, an auditor checks the tally against the karst log and wharf record. Missing, reused, or mismatched manifests burn the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 lots at 45 each: 45,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 5,000 loss. A rented manifest fails: the karst log ties each lot to one harvester. An honest agent pays 45 once, bond kept after a clean reveal.
